name: Undimmed
tagline: You never set out to change anyone. People change around you all the same.
epigraph: Poured the way one London bar pours its Martini. That bar has a famous house rule.
glassware: small stemmed cocktail glass (about 120 ml), kept in the freezer, no ice
language_row: Wren's Resonance (v3) and 4-gram pass on whoYouAre and yours: clean after four collisions from the y1/y4 rewrite were cleared ("and a lemon twist", "a teaspoon of dry", "lemon over the top", "glass with a little"); Tomás's closing line moved off "in plain sight" (*Fine by Me*). "I" only; no guest pronouns, archetype names or magic words; no sea, song, spell or seduction; never "yours" for the drink. Lint 0 errors, 0 warnings. ✓
sources: Studio fact card `_studio/fact-cards/dukes-bar-martini.md`: Oxford Companion to Spirits and Cocktails, DUKES BAR (pdf 689; primary), quoting Kingsley Amis, *Illustrated London News*, 1 Mar 1988, p. 56; Oxford VODKA (pdf 2105–2106); *A Proper Drink* pp. 22, 218 (secondary); Dukes Hotel bar page via Wayback, 25 Feb 2021 (live page 404 on 2026-10-04; no mention of the rule). Drink: *Cocktail Codex* ch. 2 "The Martini" (pp. 58–61); *Liquid Intelligence* pp. 140, 155, 305; *The Flavor Matrix* pdf 80 (citrus aroma in the zest). Web: 2 visits (Hester).
names_note: *Undimmed* (Tomás, Hester; 2–1). Wren held *Not at Half* (the person once they stop coming in at half); Hester could take it. Also considered: *Said Plainly*, *Nothing Softened*, *All of It*. Registry checked: no clash.
open_items: Balance is freeform: 65 ml with no dilution at 38.3% · 0.23 g sugar/100 ml · 0.046% acid, far above the stirred band on strength and far below on sugar and acid. Tomás justifies it in Checks: it's the page's own method (nothing added to soften it), and Oxford calls the result "a Martini of unusual strength". Robin sets no strength ceiling. Frozen vodka, the teaspoon of vermouth and grated zest are the room's choices, not the bar's (the epigraph claims only the pour). The house rule has no maker or stated reason on the page, and the 2021 house page never mentions it: its kindness is signposted ("I like to think") and nobody is named. New row `lemon_zest_grated` (garnish, none). Dossier only: the reading's Notes row still says "vodka of the two spirits the bar uses", the scope R4 fixed in y4 (recorded in audit v2). Veto-free.
